audit.streamer_or_game: Call of Duty: Warzone / Fortnite mashup
audit.framing_9x16: Standard horizontal-to-vertical crop with heavy motion blur and continuous shake, causing visual fatigue.
audit.subtitle_craft: Minimalist static text overlays synced poorly to song lyrics rather than natural dialogue, lacking dynamic pop or word chunking.
audit.zoom_and_camera_work: Excessive fisheye and shaky-cam distortion applied across the entire clip with little contextual target framing.
audit.sfx_and_music_craft: Loud, unedited rap track overlay ('Sicko Mode' remix) slapped over raw gameplay audio with no dynamic volume ducking or comedic SFX spikes.
audit.comedic_timing_and_cuts: Disjointed cuts between unrelated game clips that prioritize flashy transitions over narrative buildup or punchline delivery.
standout_techniques: Flashy white-out transitions between scene changes
Pulsing music-beat alignment for weapon inspections
anti_patterns_to_avoid: Overusing extreme motion blur and camera shake that obscures the gameplay action
Failing to balance music volume against in-game audio
